maddeler.e:
يقلعفون (form IVq)
# يَقْلَعِفُّونَ (yaqlaʕiffūna) /jaq.la.ʕif.fuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِقْلَعَفَّ (iqlaʕaffa)
# يُقْلَعَفُّونَ (yuqlaʕaffūna) /juq.la.ʕaf.fuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِقْلَعَفَّ (iqlaʕaffa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
